Files and images in the model: file and image fields, kept in a store chosen by STORAGE_URL in each environment (a folder of the disk, S3 and what speaks it, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage). A browser asks the API for an upload, sends the file straight to the store and saves the record with the file's id; the app checks the file (its size, its real format) before it is used. Files are read by signed links that expire; a file replaced, cleared or of a deleted record leaves the store, and an upload never used is cleaned up. In development the store is a folder of the project, served by the app itself.

```esquadro
blueprint storage
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [env](../env/), [http](../http/), [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/), [store](../store/), [rest](../rest/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [jobs](../jobs/), [worker](../worker/), [security](../security/), [compose](../compose/), [client_ts](../client_ts/), [spa](../spa/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/), [docker](../docker/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drivers` | list | `["s3"]` | The stores the app can open besides a folder: s3 (S3, R2, MinIO and what speaks it), gcs (Google Cloud Storage) and azure (Azure Blob Storage). Each brings its SDK into the binary. |
| `local` | name | `"disk"` | disk (a folder of the project) or s3 (a local S3 in compose.yaml, Versity S3 Gateway): the store in development. |
| `local_dir` | string | `"storage"` | The folder of a disk store in development, out of git. |
| `image_types` | list | `["png", "jpeg", "webp", "gif", "avif"]` | The formats an image field takes, and its largest size; a field's @storage(types, max) overrides them. |
| `image_max` | string | `"10MB"` |  |
| `file_types` | list | `[]` | The formats a file field takes (any when empty), and its largest size. |
| `file_max` | string | `"25MB"` |  |
| `url_minutes` | int | `60` | Minutes a link to read a file works, and one to send it. |
| `upload_minutes` | int | `15` |  |
| `pending_hours` | int | `24` | Hours after which an upload never used is deleted. |
| `clean_every` | string | `"1h"` | How often the cleanup runs, with jobs: 1h, 30m. |
| `key_layout` | name | `"entity"` | How keys are made: entity (products/photo/&lt;id>) or random (&lt;id>). |
| `check_content` | bool | `true` | Read a file's first bytes to check its real format before it is used. |

```esquadro
blueprint storage {
  drivers ["s3"]
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STORAGE_URL` | string, secret, required outside development | a value in development | Where files are kept: file://./storage (a folder), s3://bucket?region= (S3, and R2, MinIO and others with &endpoint= and &s3ForcePathStyle=true), gs://bucket or azblob://container. In development, a folder of the project (local_dir), or the local S3 of compose.yaml with local s3. |
| `STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY` | string, secret | a value in development | The keys of an S3 store, for one that is no AWS account's own (R2, MinIO and others); empty, the AWS SDK finds them (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, a role). In development, the local S3's, with local s3. |
| `STORAGE_SECRET_KEY` | string, secret | a value in development |  |
| `STORAGE_SECRET` | string, secret, required outside development | generated in development | Signs the links of a folder store (the app serves them); esquadro generates one for development. |
| `STORAGE_PREFIX` | string | `` | A prefix of every file's key, to share a bucket between apps or environments: shop/production/. |

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `max` | string | The largest file of the field: 5MB, 500KB. |
| field | `types` | list | The formats of the field: [pdf, docx], or MIME types. |
| field | `url_minutes` | int | Minutes a link to read the field's file works. |
| field | `inline` | bool | Opened in the browser; images of a safe format are, by default. |
| field | `attachment` | bool | Always downloaded, under its name; the default but for images. |

An annotation is written `@storage(key value)` on the element.
